title: Ninety Yards and a Chipped Bowl
subtitle: 盆地与流域 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 盆地与流域（自然生态·地形与水文）
meta: 主题语境：盆地与流域（自然生态·地形与水文）　|　核心词汇：basin　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 basin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my grandmother carried water in ① a basin from a pump ninety yards away, and she said the carrying was the whole of the morning. The ② basin, meaning the bowl and not the water, was chipped in 1951 and kept for eleven more years; a basin, she said, is the only thing in a house that is measured by what it has to hold.

Every ③ basin in that house had a job, and the ④ basin under the window, meaning the one for the vegetables and not either of those, was the only one that was never used for anything else. A basin, my mother said, is nine parts habit and one part a chip you have learned to avoid; my grandmother said the habit is the part that breaks.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ basin was the whole of the valley, meaning the land and not the bowl. The ⑥ basin, meaning the area the river drains and not any of that, is the only piece of country that is defined by where the water goes; a basin, he said, is either something you carry water in or the only word that means both a bowl and a country. She said the bowl came first.

By 1967 the ⑦ basin had become a word in a report about flooding, and the report had become an argument about who should pay. The ⑧ basin of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was ninety yards and eleven years; a basin, she said, is either the thing under the window or the reason you know which way the rain runs. He said the rain has always known.

The ⑨ basin I remember is the chipped one, which was still in use in 1973 and was never replaced. A ⑩ basin, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being cracked; every basin, she said, is a valley that has agreed to look like a bowl. She said the valley is the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 盆（指那只盆，与水相对）
C. 固定搭配：carry water in a basin 用盆端水
D. n. 盆（指屋里每一只）
E. n. 盆（指窗下那一只）
F. n. 盆地；流域（指那片谷地）
G. n. 盆地（抽象：河流排水的那片区域）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a basin from a pump ninety yards away
The basin, meaning the bowl and not the water
basin was the whole of the valley
The basin, meaning the area the river drains
the basin had become a word in a report about flooding
The basin of the whole thing
A basin, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: carry water in a basin 意为“用盆端水”，1948 年祖母用一只盆从九十码外的水泵端水。
basin 意为“盆”，指那只盆而不是水，它 1951 年磕了个口子，又用了十一年。
basin 指屋里每一只盆，那屋里每一只盆都有它的活儿。
basin 指窗下那一只（专洗菜的那一只），是唯一从没被挪作他用的。
basin 意为“盆地、流域”，指那片谷地，父亲说 basin 就是那片谷地的全部，指的是土地而不是那只盆。
basin 为抽象用法，指河流排水的那片区域，是唯一由水的去向来界定的一片乡野。
basin 意为“盆”，到 1967 年这个 basin 成了一份洪水报告里的一个词。
basin 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九十码和十一年。
basin 意为“盆”，我记得的是磕了口的那一只，1973 年还在用，从没被换掉。
basin 为抽象总称，母亲说盆是唯一会因为裂了而变好的东西。
